The idea we’re building toward

Keep the connections.
Keep the distinctions.

01 / Notice

Start with something real.

Begin with a question about the world. Put observations, explanations and models alongside one another, so the seams stay visible.

02 / Understand

Show the route to the answer.

Keep the route to an answer in view: where an observation came from, which method shaped it, and what remains uncertain.

03 / Respond

Leave room to change course.

Bring what we learn back to shared choices. Keep the reasons for a decision, then revisit them when the world answers back.

Inquiry stays open

A good answer makes
the next question possible.

Move from curiosity to investigation, from judgment to action—and stay willing to return.

  1. Ask
  2. Investigate
  3. Evaluate
  4. Act
  5. Revise

A common language for questions.
Room for different answers.

Every field has its own ways of asking, judging, and correcting. Claimipedia is being shaped to make those differences easier to see.
